content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: The term 'PARTY' shall mean and include the Client and Service Provider hereinafter.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._SCOPE_OF_SERVICES
content_blocks.text: The Service Provider agrees to provide the following services: web development, software implementation, and maintenance as detailed in Exhibit A.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM_AND_TERMINATION
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and terminate upon the completion of all Services unless terminated earlier by mutual agreement or as provided herein.
